_comment: Tier-2 for NGSolve phase_field#3: without a pointwise max(d, d_prev) history projection the crack heals on unloading, and the shipped phase_field_fracture_2d template never reaches that question because it reports d_max=0 forever. Verified on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh=0.15 (ne=96, VectorH1 order 1 ndof=126 dirichlet='bottom|top', H1 ndof=63), E=1 nu=0.3 Gc=1e-3 l0=0.1, schedule 0.01/0.02/0.03/0.02/0.01/0.0 (2026-08-06): the shipped elastic step `gfu.vec.data = a.mat.Inverse(FreeDofs())*f.vec` overwrites the Dirichlet entries so |u|_inf=0 and d_max=0 at all six steps; homogenising the solve gives d_max 0.014295/0.055392/0.118524 on loading and exactly the same values back down on unloading (full healing to 0); adding the projection holds d at 0.118524 through the unloading. Also pins the template's second defect: GridFunction.Set(definedon=...) zeroes every other DOF, so its two consecutive Set calls leave only the bottom displacement applied. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 turns the history projection on in the run that is supposed to heal -- run(True, False) becomes run(True, True), i.e. the documented pointwise gnew = max(gnew, gprev) is applied there too. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604: the unmutated run matches all 13 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 removes 'no_projection_damage_decreased_on_unload=True' and 'no_projection_final_dmax_below_half_peak=True' so the fixture goes red. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py
